note: These four files are COMMITTED in the repository, so a normal clone already has them and scripts/fetch-lab-data.mjs does nothing. They are also published as GitHub Release assets as a recovery path: a shallow or partial clone, or a file deleted by accident, can be restored without re-cloning. Each entry records the size, SHA-256 and how to rebuild the file from its original public source. Git LFS was considered for hosting them and rejected: its free tier meters 1 GB per month of bandwidth, which roughly six student clones exhaust, after which clones fail outright rather than slowing down.
